command.name: Cunning Whispers
verbatim: Each Round: 30% chance to reduce Instinct and Initiative by -15% (enhanced by Initiative) of 1 Enemy in the same lane for 2 round(s).
Rounds 2, 5, 8: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +120%).

At 10 Stars: Round 1: reduce Instinct and Initiative by -6% (enhanced by Initiative) of the Enemy with the highest Instinct until the end of combat. Rounds 3, 6, 9: Deal Fire Damage to all Enemies that deal Tactical Damage (Damage Rate: +30%), doubled against targets afflicted with Panic.

vanguard.name: Hunter's Wrath
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Strength and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Enervate
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Tactical Damage Dealt by -8% of 1 Enemy that deals Tactical Damage until the end of combat.

habits.name: Second Wind
habits.verbatim: Round 6: Increase your Damage Dealt by +10% until the end of combat. Recover your troops (Recovery Rate: +150%), then Nullify Recovery until the end of combat.

habits.name: Whispering Sabotage
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to afflict Weakened (-10%) on 1 Enemy in the same lane for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Quick-Witted
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Intelligence and Initiative by +12.5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Echoes of Deceit
habits.verbatim: Cunning Whispers gains: Round 1: reduce Instinct and Initiative by -6% (enhanced by Initiative) of the Enemy with the highest Instinct until the end of combat. Rounds 3, 6, 9: Deal Fire Damage to all Enemies that deal Tactical Damage (Damage Rate: +30%), doubled against targets afflicted with Panic.
